title: Equinix
summary: US colocation and interconnection REIT operating data centres in major metros.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Equinix leases colocation space and cross-connects in carrier-dense metros, which makes it the neutral meeting point for networks, clouds and enterprises. AI workloads need more power and cooling than traditional colocation, and the company is retrofitting and building xScale facilities with partners to serve hyperscale demand. Power availability, not land, is now the limiting factor for growth.

Technology Exposure

  • Colocation and cross-connect revenue
  • xScale hyperscale joint ventures
  • Interconnection and peering

What To Watch

  • Power secured for new capacity
  • Pricing power in tight metros
  • Capex intensity and development yields

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.

businessMeaning: Interconnection is the moat: the value of a data centre is who else is already inside it.
investmentLens: A REIT with utility-like recurring revenue, increasingly priced on AI capacity and power access rather than office-like leasing.
